entries.what: Rode the 7:02 Tule Line from Flats Junction with a large masala chai from Anh's cart, then sat through MWF classes at Bayshore State on the first day of the fall term.
entries.outcome: Got his class schedule locked in and noted his section times.

entries.what: Worked a front desk shift at the Bayshore career center, then updated the spreadsheet (63 applications) and resume v14 at his desk at Marisol Gardens.
entries.outcome: Added a few new rows; still no interviews.

entries.what: Stayed up until about 2 a.m. tweaking resume bullets while Marcus was at his Ridgeline night shift.
entries.outcome: Went to bed late again.

entries.what: Caught the 7:02 north and went to operations management with Dr. Ashby at 10:30, sitting near the front.
entries.outcome: Got the syllabus and noted Ashby's Thursday office hours.

entries.what: Sent a few alum LinkedIn messages and added internship applications to the spreadsheet between classes.
entries.outcome: Spreadsheet still at 63 while he drafted new ones.

entries.what: Thursday-style laundry skipped; instead bought groceries at Ruiz Family Market for his Sunday meal prep and went home.
entries.outcome: Stocked rajma ingredients early.

entries.what: The heat wave started; the 7:02 was packed and stuffy, and he stood most of the ride to Bayshore for MWF morning classes.
entries.outcome: Arrived sweaty but on time.

entries.what: Worked his career center desk shift in the air conditioning and fielded student questions about resumes.
entries.outcome: Enjoyed the cool office.

entries.what: Apartment was hot in the evening; he worked on applications with the window open, Marcus asleep before his shift.
entries.outcome: Got three applications done despite the heat.

entries.what: Took the 7:02 to operations management at 10:30 with Dr. Ashby in the middle of the heat wave.
entries.outcome: Sat through a lecture on supply-chain basics.

entries.what: Dropped by Ashby's Thursday office hours just to introduce himself, planning for a letter later.
entries.outcome: Brief, polite chat; no ask yet.

entries.what: Did laundry at the card-only laundry room at Marisol Gardens Thursday night, editing his resume on his laptop while waiting.
entries.outcome: Clean clothes and a slightly tweaked v14.

entries.what: Commuted in 100-degree heat on the 7:02 and joked to himself about the ride, then did MWF classes at Bayshore.
entries.outcome: Survived the commute.

entries.what: That evening he looked for a cheap fan setup for the apartment, joking that the heat wave was a free sauna with his commute.
entries.outcome: Decided on a $20 box fan within his food budget.

entries.what: Worked on the spreadsheet and applications late at night.
entries.outcome: Spreadsheet still at 63 rows.

entries.what: Skipped the marsh boardwalk run because of the heat and ran early before sunrise instead, briefly.
entries.outcome: Short run, then home.

entries.what: Spent the afternoon on applications at the apartment with the fan going while Marcus slept after night shift.
entries.outcome: Submitted two applications quietly.

entries.what: Ate rajma and rice from his containers and watched cricket highlights with lo-fi on.
entries.outcome: Relaxed evening.

entries.what: Went to his parents' Pell Road house for Sunday dinner and then langar, where Gurpreet asked about a CDL again.
entries.outcome: Came home with a tub of dal.

entries.what: Took his mother's Sunday call about internships, telling her no interviews yet.
entries.outcome: She nudged him to apply more; he promised to.

entries.what: Meal-prepped four containers of rajma and rice and planned the week's applications.
entries.outcome: Food for the week ready.
